bettercoords.config.title: Better Coords
bettercoords.config.enabled.tooltip:
ON: F3 shows only your XYZ coordinates.
OFF: vanilla F3 screen.
bettercoords.config.glitch.tooltip:
ON: the coordinates (and the facing line) turn into constantly shifting junk glyphs.
OFF: normal numbers.
bettercoords.config.facing.tooltip:
ON: a second line shows which way you are looking, like the vanilla debug screen.
OFF: coordinates only.
bettercoords.config.fake.enabled.tooltip:
OFF: your real coordinates are shown.
ON: the spot you are standing on is shown as the X/Y/Z below, and moving offsets from there.
bettercoords.config.fake.reanchor: Re-anchor to where I am now
bettercoords.config.fake.reanchor.toolti: Makes your current position count as the fake coordinates again, without changing the numbers.
bettercoords.config.fake.info: Example: standing at 50 100 50 with 1000 100 1000 entered, walking 100 blocks in +Z shows 1000 100 1100.
